questions.prompt: You just bought a used car. How long do you have to transfer ownership into your name?
questions.explanation: When you buy a vehicle, you have 10 days to transfer ownership. A seller has five days to notify the DMV.

questions.prompt: You move to California with a car registered in another state. How long do you have to register it here?
questions.explanation: You have 20 days to register an out-of-state vehicle after becoming a resident or taking a job in California.
